verdict.rationale: PostHog documents strong error/session-replay linkage (AI Observability traces come with 'the user who triggered it, their session replay, and any exceptions the request threw', PostHog AI 'finds the session replay' when answering questions, and feature-flag rollouts let you 'see the session replays, events, and exceptions from the people who got the flag'), which supports jumping from errors to replays. However there is no explicit documentation of clicking from a funnel drop-off step directly into filtered session replays of the affected users.  Missing for 10: explicit funnel-insight-to-replay deep link, independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific PM workflow.
